items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: In the meantime Stan Getz and all those guys would go around to his room every night... He said, 'Stay here.' Maybe we can get these guys to leave... did he -- did he resent the people like Getz who were -- No. No, he kind of liked it, because everybody knew that was him.

ctx.x: was something like that. Anyway, there was no case of -- Johnny had to pay $25 each for them. But we got to Los Angeles and it was there that McShann joined us. And we played the Plantation Club and then McShann had to go back to the Army. Now, he's inducted into the Army.
You told me he was inducted right after Stan, in --
Yeah, well, what had happened, he had been inducted but they gave him permission to come back.
